subject: cloud-bodied ibis
art_direction: 云朵身体配长弯喙与两条短腿，羽翼像折起的毛毡信封，侧头偷看。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create an ibis-like creature whose body is a compact scalloped cloud made from thick wool felt. Give it one long curved charcoal beak, two short folded legs, and wings shaped like opened envelopes. Turn the body sideways while the head looks back toward the viewer with dry curiosity. Use cream felt, muted sea-green seams, and one vermilion wing lining. Set it against flat charcoal-blue paper. Show a few deliberate blanket stitches and soft fiber edges, avoiding realistic feathers, scenic backgrounds, and excessive tiny details. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
